name: NPV
desc: Net Present Value: sum of discounted cash flows minus initial cost

name: IRR
desc: Internal Rate of Return: discount rate that makes NPV = 0

name: WACC
desc: Weighted Average Cost of Capital; V = E + D total firm value

name: Gordon Growth
desc: Stock price = next dividend / (cost of equity - growth rate)

name: Contribution Margin
desc: Revenue available to cover fixed costs and profit

name: Break-even
desc: Units needed to cover all costs; P = price, VC = variable cost/unit

name: DuPont ROE
expr: ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier
desc: Breaks down return on equity into three drivers

name: Operating Leverage
desc: Measures sensitivity of EBIT to changes in sales

name: EOQ
desc: Economic Order Quantity; D=annual demand, S=order cost, H=holding cost

name: Reorder Point
desc: When to place order; d=daily demand, L=lead time, z=service level

name: OEE
desc: Overall Equipment Effectiveness; world class ≥ 85%

name: EMSR-b
desc: Expected Marginal Seat Revenue-b: protection level for class j

name: Newsvendor Q*
desc: Optimal order qty; Cu=underage cost, Co=overage cost

name: Critical Ratio
desc: Scheduling priority; CR < 1 means job is behind schedule

name: Little's Law
desc: Average items in system = arrival rate × average time in system

name: Z-score
desc: Standardised score: how many standard deviations from the mean

name: t-statistic
desc: For hypothesis testing when population σ is unknown

name: Regression
desc: β₁ = slope; R² = proportion of variance explained

name: Bayes Theorem
desc: Posterior probability given new evidence

name: Confidence Interval
desc: Range likely to contain true population mean

name: Chi-square
desc: Tests independence between categorical variables

name: BCG Matrix
expr: Relative MS = Brand MS / Largest Competitor MS
desc: Market share vs growth: Stars, Cash Cows, Question Marks, Dogs

name: Porter Value Chain
desc: Primary: inbound, ops, outbound, marketing, service; Support: HR, tech, infra

name: Nash Equilibrium
desc: Each player's strategy is best response to all others' strategies

name: WACC Hurdle Rate
desc: A project creates value only if its return exceeds the cost of capital

name: Ansoff Matrix
expr: Growth = f(Market × Product) new vs existing
desc: Market penetration, development, product development, diversification

name: Maslow Hierarchy
desc: Lower needs must be met before higher needs motivate

name: Herzberg 2-Factor
desc: Hygiene prevents dissatisfaction; motivators create satisfaction

name: PERMA
desc: Positive emotions, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment

name: OEE (HR version)
desc: Employee productivity metric analogous to machine OEE
